sources.title: Chicago current-active business licenses: hotel activity query
sources.geography: City of Chicago licensed business addresses
limitations: Hotel business activity676 means seven or more sleeping rooms; room capacity is not a dataset field.
226 returned active-view rows include11 future-start license terms. Current-term filter yields215 license numbers,214 account-site pairs,209 exact addresses. These units are not interchangeable.

No verified ownership/brand independence or boutique flag; no Airbnb matching, allocation or booking inference.
The historical Hotel license code1370 returned1402 terms ending by2015 and was excluded from current supply; modern hotel records use Regulated Business License activity676.

sources.title: Los Angeles TMD hotel directory
sources.geography: City of Los Angeles Tourism Marketing District:50+room lodging subset
limitations: Official TMD directory subset, not all City of Los Angeles hotels; July2024 district plan applies to public-occupancy lodging with50+rooms in city boundaries. Smaller boutique hotels are structurally omitted.
173 distinct directory URLs;172 explicit Total Rooms fields; Bonnie Lee Inn missing. Rooms are undated profile facts retrieved2026-09-07, not audited current operating capacity.
35,501 is the arithmetic sum of reported profile fields. Three shared-address brand pairs are retained; physical room overlap has not been independently reconciled.
Postal address place names differ from municipal jurisdiction. City membership follows the TMD directory/plan, not a naive Los Angeles postal-name filter.
No verified independent/boutique classification, Airbnb eligibility, contracted allocation, availability or booking inference.
